notes.title: Valentine's Day Release and Discount!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34399088/9b104063d2e1f9a0a52fad8ec7504e658773207a.pngHello, everyone!
Thank you for taking the time to look at our game! 

We will be offering a 10% discount around Valentine's Day since this is the perfect game to play with your sweetheart! Enjoy frantic flying, crashing, and destroying some rather evil asteroids with your partner all while trying to best your high score!

If you'd like to hear more about us or the game visit our steam forums!
